description.zh:
开启状态：

- OPEN：开启
- CLOSE：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the health check feature. Valid values:

*   OPEN: enables the health check feature.
*   CLOSE: disables the health check feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns set-dns-gtm-monitor-status --lang en --monitor-config-id Monito00000 --status OPEN --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SetDnsGtmMonitorStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status OPEN --Lang en --MonitorConfigId Monito00000
